title: Quantum-Classical Neural Networks for Solving Lindblad Master Equations
abstract: arXiv:2610.22691v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Variational quantum algorithms have emerged as a promising approach for simulating open quantum systems, yet their expressive power and trainability remain poorly understood. We propose a variational framework for solving Lindblad master equations by minimizing a residual cost function using a compositional ansatz obtained by combining a classical neural network with a parameterized quantum circuit. The density matrix is represented through a purification on an enlarged Hilbert space, ensuring positivity, Hermiticity, and unit trace by construction, while all gradients are evaluated exactly via the parameter-shift rule. Beyond the algorithmic formulation, we derive an upper bound for the covering number of the proposed compositional model and compare it with that of purely quantum neural networks. translated_title: 用于求解林德布拉德主方程的量子-经典神经网络
translated_abstract: 变分量子算法已成为模拟开放量子系统的一种有前景的方法，但其表达能力和可训练性仍鲜为人知。我们提出了一个求解林德布拉德主方程的变分框架，通过将经典神经网络与参数化量子电路相结合构成复合拟设，并最小化残差代价函数。密度矩阵通过在扩大的希尔伯特空间上的纯化来表示，从而在构造上保证了正定性、厄米性和单位迹，同时所有梯度均通过参数移位规则精确计算。除算法设计之外，我们还推导了所提出的复合模型覆盖数的上界，并将其与纯量子神经网络的覆盖数进行比较。我们的分析表明，经典参数化扩大了有效假设类，同时对其复杂度提供了更精细的控制。
tldr: 该论文提出一种结合经典神经网络与参数化量子电路的变分框架来求解林德布拉德主方程，通过纯化表示在构造上保证密度矩阵的物理性质，并从理论上证明经典参数化能够扩大有效假设类、提升模型的表达能力与可控性。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a variational framework combining classical neural networks with parameterized quantum circuits to solve Lindblad master equations, guaranteeing physical properties of the density matrix by construction via purification, and theoretically showing that classical parametrization enlarges the effective hypothesis class while providing finer control over model complexity.
